title: Reduce successor of two
description: This reduction expands SUCC TWO into the Church numeral THREE.

steps.description: The expression applies SUCC to the Church numeral TWO.
Substituting TWO for n leaves a function that applies f around TWO's iteration.
The inner Church numeral receives f and then x.

steps.question: How many nested applications of f remain after the final beta reduction?
steps.answer: Three nested applications of f remain.

steps.description: The final term applies f three times to x. That behavior is the Church numeral THREE.
